1: # THIRD EYE — Industry-Grade Agentic IDE
2: 
3: **THIRD EYE** is a high-performance, enterprise-grade, AI-native Integrated Development Environment (IDE) architected with a decoupled 4-process topology. It unifies terminal multiplexing, Monaco editor workflows, file system virtualization, and an autonomous coding agent loop with side-effect transparency.
4: 
5: ---
6: 
7: ## 🏗️ 4-Process System Architecture
8: 
9: ```text
10: THIRD_EYE/
11: ├── package.json                         # Monorepo workspaces: packages/*, Frontend/*, backend/*
12: ├── packages/
13: │   └── shared/                          # ★ CONTRACT LAYER (@third-eye/shared)
14: │       ├── src/ipc.ts                   # Channel constants + typed Request/Response signatures
15: │       ├── src/tools.ts                 # Tool schemas, parameters, and risk classifications
16: │       ├── src/events.ts                # Streaming terminal, file watch, and agent events
17: │       ├── src/agent.ts                 # Message turns, tool calls, checkpoints, context envelopes
18: │       └── src/permissions.ts           # Permission requests, decisions, and auto-allow policy
19: │
20: ├── electron/                            # 🖥️ DESKTOP WRAPPER (Electron Main Process)
21: │   ├── main.js                          # Window manager, chokidar file watcher, typed IPC router
22: │   ├── preload.js                       # Secure ContextBridge exposing window.thirdEye & legacy adapters
23: │   ├── ptyManager.js                    # Native PTY engine adapter
24: │   └── aiEngine.js                      # Legacy adapter for backward compatibility
25: │
26: ├── Frontend/guide-build-main/           # 🎨 RENDERER PROCESS (React 18 + TanStack + Monaco)
27: │   ├── src/editor/                      # ★ In-Memory File Model Registry & Diff Preview
28: │   │   ├── fileModels.ts                # In-memory models, versioning, external watch sync
29: │   │   └── diffPreview/                 # Monaco Diff Editor for AI proposed hunk reviews
30: │   ├── src/components/ai-assistant/     # AI Sidecar with Slash Commands & Checkpoint Restore
31: │   ├── src/components/terminal/         # High-performance xterm.js terminal integration
32: │   └── src/hooks/useEditorWorkspace.ts  # Workspace models & diff review actions
33: │
34: ├── backend/
35: │   ├── pty-service/                     # ⚙️ PTY MICROSERVICE (Port 4001)
36: │   │   ├── src/sessionRegistry.ts       # Session coordinator (id → process, cwd, shell)
37: │   │   ├── src/outputBus.ts             # 10,000-line circular ring buffer for late subscribers
38: │   │   ├── src/shellIntegration.ts      # OSC 633 & OSC 7 sequence parser (cwd & exit code tracking)
39: │   │   └── src/server.ts                # REST & WebSocket streaming server
40: │   │
41: │   ├── ai-service/                      # 🧠 AI AGENT MICROSERVICE (Port 4002)
42: │   │   ├── src/loop.ts                  # ★ Autonomous 5-Step Agent Loop (max 25 iterations)
43: │   │   ├── src/tools/                   # Tool registry (readFile, writeFile, editFile, searchCode, runTerminal)
44: │   │   ├── src/context/                 # Context engineering (repoMap, chunker, retriever, budgetManager, compaction)
45: │   │   ├── src/tools/checkpoints.ts     # Content-hash snapshot store for 1-click rollback
46: │   │   └── src/tools/permissions.ts     # Policy engine enforcing user permission decisions
47: │   │
48: │   └── salesforce-service/              # ☁️ SALESFORCE INTEGRATION MICROSERVICE (Port 4003)
49: │
50: ├── scripts/
51: │   └── smoke-test.js                    # Automated E2E smoke test verifying all 4 processes
52: └── docs/
53:     ├── ARCHITECTURE.md                  # Comprehensive process map, data flows, and IPC contracts
54:     ├── AGENT.md                         # Autonomous agent mental model, loop, and budget policy
55:     └── MIGRATION_LOG.md                 # Complete record of all migration phases (0 through 7)
56: ```
57: 
58: ---
59: 
60: ## ⚡ Non-Negotiable Hard Constraints Enforced
61: 
62: 1. **Zero Ground-Up Rewrite**: Incremental migration preserving all existing features behind typed contracts.
63: 2. **4-Process Architecture**: Strict separation of Electron Main | Renderer | pty-service | ai-service.
64: 3. **Typed Contracts Everywhere**: Inter-process communication strictly mediated by `@third-eye/shared`. No untyped string IPC.
65: 4. **File Model Service**: Every agent write/edit routes through in-memory models and produces reviewable Monaco diff previews before persistent disk writes.
66: 5. **Tool Permissions**: Every terminal command requires explicit permission decision unless matching the auto-allow list (`git status`, `ls`, `pwd`, etc.).
67: 6. **Side-Effect Transparency & Checkpoints**: Content-hash snapshots recorded prior to each mutation, enabling single-click "Revert All AI Changes".
68: 
69: ---
70: 
71: ## 🚀 Running THIRD EYE
72: 
73: ### 1. Environment Configuration
74: Verify your [`.env`](file:///Users/adityasalgotra/Downloads/THIRD_EYE/.env) in the root directory:
75: ```env
76: GEMINI_API_KEY=your_gemini_api_key_here
77: GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-3.5-flash
78: # Optional OpenAI fallback
79: OPENAI_API_KEY=your_openai_api_key_here
80: ```
81: 
82: ### 2. Build Workspaces
83: ```bash
84: # Build the contract layer
85: npm run build:shared
86: 
87: # Run the end-to-end smoke test
88: npm run smoke
89: ```
90: 
91: ### 3. Launch Development Stack
92: ```bash
93: npm run dev
94: ```
95: Starts all 4 services concurrently:
96: - **PTY Service**: `http://localhost:4001` (WebSocket: `ws://localhost:4001/pty/stream`)
97: - **AI Agent Service**: `http://localhost:4002`
98: - **Salesforce Service**: `http://localhost:4003`
99: - **Frontend Web App**: `http://localhost:3000`
100: - **Electron Client**: Native desktop application with typed `window.thirdEye` bridge.

It unifies high-performance terminal multiplexing, Monaco editor workflows, file system virtualization, and an autonomous LLM coding agent loop. 5: 6: ```mermaid 7: graph TD 8: subgraph UI_Layer ["Renderer Process (React + TanStack + Monaco)"] 9: WB["Workbench Grid / Shell Layout"] 10: ED["EditorHost (Monaco + Diff Preview)"] 11: FMS["File Model Registry (In-Memory)"] 12: TM["TerminalHost (xterm.js)"] 13: EXP["Explorer Tree (Virtualized)"] 14: CP["AI Sidecar / Chat Panel"] 15: TC["Typed Bridge Client (window.thirdEye)"] 16: end 17: 18: subgraph Desktop_Core ["Electron Main Process"] 19: IPC["Typed IPC Router (packages/shared)"] 20: WIN["Window Manager & Lifecycle"] 21: FW["File Watcher (chokidar)"] 22: PTYM["PTY Native Adapter"] 23: CLIP["Clipboard & Dialog Services"] 24: end 25: 26: subgraph Service_Mesh ["Backend Microservices"] 27: PTYS["PTY Service (:4001)
Session Registry + OutputBus Ring Buffer"] 28: AIS["AI Agent Service (:4002)
Loop + Tool Registry + Context Engine + Checkpoints"] 29: SFS["Salesforce Integration Service (:4003)"] 30: end 31: 32: TC <==> |Preload contextBridge| IPC 33: IPC <==> |Internal IPC / Stream| FW 34: IPC <==> |TCP / WebSocket| PTYS 35: IPC <==> |HTTP / SSE EventBus| AIS 36: AIS <==> |Tool: runTerminal| PTYS 37: AIS <==> |Tool: Salesforce| SFS 38: ED <==> FMS 39: ``` 40: 41: --- 42: 43: ## 2. Process Architecture 44: 45: | Process | Runtime | Primary Responsibilities | Network / IPC Boundaries | 46: | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | 47: | **Electron Main** | Node.js (Electron 29) | Native OS windowing, file watcher, native dialogs, IPC routing | Preload bridge `window.thirdEye` | 48: | **Renderer** | React 18 / Vite / TanStack | Workbench layout, Monaco editor, in-memory file models, xterm.js terminals, Agent chat UI | `window.thirdEye` typed contract | 49: | **PTY Service** | Node.js (:4001) | `node-pty` process orchestration, 10,000-line circular ring buffer (`outputBus`), shell integration (OSC parsing) | WebSocket `/pty/stream` + REST | 50: | **AI Agent Service** | Node.js (:4002) | Autonomous loop (`loop.ts`), tool registry, context budgeting, AST repo-map, checkpoints | HTTP REST + SSE streaming | 51: | **Salesforce Service** | Node.js (:4003) | SOQL querying, apex inspection, Salesforce metadata deployment | HTTP REST | 52: 53: --- 54: 55: ## 3. The Contract Layer (`packages/shared`) 56: All inter-process communication is governed by typed schemas in `@third-eye/shared`: 57: - `ipc.ts`: Channel constants and typed Request/Response signatures. 58: - `tools.ts`: Tool declarations, risk levels (`low`, `medium`, `high`), and parameter schemas. 59: - `events.ts`: Event delta schemas for terminal data, file watcher events, agent token deltas, and background tasks. 60: - `agent.ts`: Unified envelope, message turns, tool invocations, results, and checkpoints. 61: - `permissions.ts`: Decision engine types (`allow_once`, `allow_session`, `reject`). 62: 63: --- 64: 65: ## 4. The Agentic Flow (`loop.ts`) 66: The AI coding agent loop in `backend/ai-service/src/loop.ts` follows a strict 5-stage state machine: 67: 1. **Context Construction**: Assembles system prompt, workspace repo-map summary, active Monaco tab + selection, file chunk retriever results, recent terminal tail (last 200 lines), and conversation history. Enforces strict token budgets. 68: 2. **Model Streaming**: Streams LLM generation. Emits text deltas in real-time via SSE. 69: 3. **Tool Call & Permission Gate**: 70: - If tool is mutating (`writeFile`, `editFile`), a snapshot checkpoint is taken first. 71: - If tool requires permission (e.g., terminal command outside auto-allow list), halts and dispatches `PermissionRequest` to UI. 72: 4. **Execution & Sandboxing**: Executes tool through typed handlers. Direct `fs.writeFile` is strictly forbidden; file edits produce reviewable diffs in the File Model Service. 73: 5. **Observation Feedback**: Formats tool output (or errors) as observations back into the context envelope and iterates up to $N$ turns (default 25) until `finish_reason == stop`. 74: 75: --- 76: 77: ## 5. File Model Service & Side-Effect Transparency 78: Direct disk writes from the agent are forbidden. 79: 1. `editFile` / `writeFile` emits a proposed delta `{ path, original, modified, hunkRange }`. 80: 2. The renderer's `fileModels.ts` receives the delta and mounts it as a reviewable diff in Monaco Diff Editor. 81: 3. User can **Accept Hunk**, **Accept All**, or **Reject**. 82: 4. Checkpoints are stored in `.third-eye/checkpoints/` before every commit, enabling single-click "Revert All AI Changes". 83:

1: # THIRD_EYE Autonomous Agent Specification
2: 
3: ## 1. Agent Mental Model & Principles
4: The THIRD_EYE agent is an autonomous, context-aware coding partner designed to mirror senior developer workflows. It operates under five foundational principles:
5: 
6: 1. **Context-First, Not Token-Dumping**: The agent never reads 1,000-line files blindly. It relies on the Workspace Repo-Map, symbol search, and line-bounded chunk retrievers.
7: 2. **Side-Effect Transparency**: Every mutating operation produces visible diffs before persistent disk mutation. Checkpoints are recorded prior to state changes.
8: 3. **Safe Execution**: High-risk terminal commands (e.g. `rm -rf`, destructive migrations, package deletions) require explicit user permission unless matching the workspace auto-allow policy.
9: 4. **Resilience to Failure**: Tool failures, compiler errors, and command non-zero exits are treated as informative observations, not system crashes.
10: 5. **Background Task Awareness**: Long-running background jobs (e.g., dev servers, test runners) return detached task handles, allowing continuous agent work while polling output tails.
11: 
12: ---
13: 
14: ## 2. The Autonomous Agent Loop (`backend/ai-service/src/loop.ts`)
15: 
16: ```mermaid
17: sequenceDiagram
18:     autonumber
19:     actor User
20:     participant Renderer as Renderer (ChatPanel & Monaco)
21:     participant Loop as Agent Loop (ai-service)
22:     participant Ctx as Context Engine (repoMap/retriever)
23:     participant Perm as Policy Engine (permissions.ts)
24:     participant Tools as Tool Registry
25:     participant PTY as PTY Service (:4001)
26: 
27:     User->>Renderer: Submit task or prompt
28:     Renderer->>Loop: POST /api/ai/agent/stream
29:     Loop->>Ctx: Build Context Envelope (Budget ≤ 128k)
30:     Ctx-->>Loop: Envelope {System, RepoMap, Tabs, Tail, History}
31:     
32:     loop Max 25 Iterations
33:         Loop->>Loop: Stream LLM Generation
34:         Loop-->>Renderer: SSE text-delta (Smooth fading render)
35:         alt Model requests ToolCall
36:             Loop->>Perm: Check Risk Level & Grants
37:             alt Requires User Permission
38:                 Loop-->>Renderer: SSE permission_request
39:                 Renderer->>User: Display PermissionPrompt
40:                 User->>Renderer: Decision (allow_once | allow_session | reject)
41:                 Renderer->>Loop: POST /api/ai/agent/permission_decision
42:             end
43:             alt Tool == editFile / writeFile
44:                 Loop->>Loop: Snapshot Checkpoint (content hash)
45:                 Loop->>Tools: Generate In-Memory Diff
46:                 Tools-->>Renderer: Mount Reviewable Diff in Monaco
47:             else Tool == runTerminal
48:                 Loop->>PTY: Execute in session (streaming / background)
49:                 PTY-->>Tools: Output tail (last 200 lines) + exitCode
50:             end
51:             Tools-->>Loop: ToolResult observation
52:             Loop->>Loop: Append ToolResult to Context Envelope
53:         else Model emits STOP
54:             Loop-->>Renderer: SSE finish (status: complete)
55:         end
56:     end
57: ```
58: 
59: ---
60: 
61: ## 3. Tool Specifications & Risk Matrix
62: 
63: | Tool | Risk Level | Permission Requirement | Description |
64: | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
65: | `readFile` | Low | Auto-allowed | Reads file with line-number slices; respects `.gitignore` |
66: | `listFiles` / `listDir` | Low | Auto-allowed | Virtual directory tree scan |
67: | `searchCode` | Low | Auto-allowed | Pattern & regex code search |
68: | `getDiagnostics` | Low | Auto-allowed | Compiler & linter error extraction |
69: | `writeFile` | Medium | Requires File Model Diff Preview | Creates or replaces file via in-memory model |
70: | `editFile` | Medium | Requires File Model Diff Preview | Precise search/replace hunk edits with fuzzy fallback |
71: | `runTerminal` | High / Configurable | Decision required unless command is in auto-allow list | Runs shell commands; supports `background: true` returning `taskId` |
72: | `salesforceQuery` | Medium | Auto-allowed (read-only SOQL) | Executes SOQL queries via salesforce microservice |
73: | `restoreCheckpoint` | Medium | Prompt confirmation | Reverts workspace to a previous checkpoint hash |
74: 
75: ---
76: 
77: ## 4. Context Budget Management (128k Window)
78: 
79: ```
80: [================= CONTEXT WINDOW ALLOCATION (128K TOKENS) =================]
81: [ System & Tool Schemas: 20% ] [ Repo-Map Index: 15% ] [ Working Tabs/Tail: 25% ] [ Turn History: 40% ]
82: ```
83: 
84: When context approaches 85% of budget:
85: 1. Low-relevance retrieval chunks are dropped first.
86: 2. Old turns are summarized via `compaction.ts`, retaining key decisions and tool output summaries while discarding raw logs.
